description: This file defines the Statistics model class for the OpenCart admin reporting module. It contains methods for retrieving and modifying statistical data stored in the database.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Model class for handling statistical data, extending the system's base model class.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistical records from the database.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value for a specific statistic identified by the code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value of a specific statistic by the provided amount.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value of a specific statistic by the provided amount.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific statistic to a new value.
